messages:
oliver: FYI — two Expo users filed issues: EAS build fails on 'stream/web' import and TS complains about Buffer types. Blocker for quickstart.

meera: Metro is resolving our ESM module as the main entry. We don't currently provide a react-native export so it picks dist/esm which pulls in node/web-streams.

dan: Quick patch idea: add a 'react-native' subpath in exports that points to dist/rn/index.js. Dist/rn should avoid 'stream/web', not reference Node Buffer, and check for globalThis.crypto.

polly: Also saw a runtime crash on Hermes when retrying after 401. Our retry clones request body which RN fetch can't clone. Crash: "TypeError: request body cannot be cloned".

oliver: That explains some of the EAS reports. Proposed fixes:
- add conditional exports with "react-native" target
- build a minimal dist/rn bundle that uses web-compatible APIs or runtime shims
- change retry middleware to buffer small bodies and error with a clear message for non-cloneable streams

meera: Types: current .d.ts references Node types which drags @types/node into RN TS projects. We should ship dist/rn/index.d.ts without Node types (use Uint8Array) and map it via exports/types or a separate types field.

dan: For onboarding, add an examples/expo-minimal that lists exact deps: 'expo', 'react-native-get-random-values' or 'expo-random', and shows the tiny shim to set globalThis.crypto early. Keep README troubleshooting short and copy-paste.

polly: Small diagnostic helper at startup would help support: detectMissingGlobals() that logs which of crypto, ReadableStream, AbortController are missing and points to docs. Saves tickets.

oliver: I'll open a PR that adds the RN export + a runtime warning and updates retry logic. Meera can author the RN .d.ts and example. Dan will add a CI metro-resolver smoke test.

qa-bot: Created DEVEX-5230: "Expo quickstart: RN export, retry fix, RN types, example app" assigned to oliver, meera, dan. ETA 5 days.

meera: Will also include a short note about EAS: make sure metro doesn't resolve node core polyfills and don't rely on automatic node shimming.

dan: on it. small, backwards-compatible changes only.

oliver: Thanks team — unblock onboarding quickly and we can iterate on polish. :rocket:
